create_module_ast_patcher: create a ModuleASTPatcher to patch module members by matching and replacing AST nodes
build_patch_settings: build PatchSettings with prefix code and allow_num_matches_upto tolerance for multiple AST matches
install_module_patches: install AST patches on a target module using ModuleASTPatcher.install() for threadsafe patching
install_clean_module_patches: install_clean patches on a freshly-imported module to ensure all downstream imports see patched code
patch_module_context_manager: patch module members temporarily using ModuleASTPatcher as a with context manager
